enEdits.find: - Two small moons, Phobos and Deimos, likely captured asteroids
enEdits.replace: - Two small moons, Phobos and Deimos, whose origin is still unsettled. Their spectra resemble those of primitive asteroids, suggesting Mars captured them; but their nearly circular orbits, lying almost in the equatorial plane, fit better with a scenario in which they accreted from a debris disk thrown up by a giant impact. JAXA counts this among the unsolved problems of Solar System formation, and launched the MMX mission to bring back a sample of Phobos and settle the question
